label: preparing
what: They are coordinating a publicly open community gathering/hospitality arrangement in the great hall, including refreshments, deliveries, and hall lighting. The three committee participants (innkeeper, builder, freight) arranged refreshments; an order for 120 loaves was baked, and builder separately paid for 80 additional loaves. The original 120-loaf payment is unverified. No bridge/port changes or treasury spending were proposed. The secretary knowingly assists by arranging/recording the appointment and escort, but there is no evidence she is a planning committee member. The neighbour is aware and intends to attend, but is not shown knowingly helping organize.
